Fields.Label: Sample Identifier
Fields.Description: This identifier uniquely identifies the samples for immunohistochemistry. The identifier has time point details where PRE indicates baseline or before treatment while WK3 and WK8 indicate the timepoint. The identifier ends with ihc indicating the immunohistochemistry sample.
Fields.Comment: This is a unique identifier for each sample, indicating both the subject and the time point at which the sample was collected.

Fields.Label: Biomarker Name
Fields.Description: Param in case of immunohistochemistry data table indicates the biomarker/parameter measured using immunohistochemistry.
Fields.Comment: This specifies the biological parameter that is being measured. In this dataset, the parameter is PD-L1, which is a protein associated with the immune response

Fields.Label: Cells/mm2 Sample
Fields.Description: This gives number of cells per square millimeter showing presence of parameter measured (eg. PD-L1). This measurement gives an idea of the density of marker (eg. PD-L1) expressing cells at a particular time point for a subject.
Fields.Comment: The number of PD-L1 positive cells per square millimeter in the specific sample. This measurement gives an idea of the density of PD-L1 expressing cells at a particular time point for a subject.

Fields.Label: Cells/mm2 Mean
Fields.Description: This gives mean number of cells per square millimeter showing presence of parameter measured (eg. PD-L1). This measurement gives a central tendancy of the density of marker (eg. PD-L1) expressing cells at a particular time point for a subject.
Fields.Comment: The mean number of PD-L1 positive cells per square millimeter calculated across multiple replicates or samples for a particular condition or subject.

Fields.Label: Cells/mm2 SD
Fields.Description: This gives standard deviation of the number of cells per square millimeter measured across multiple fields showing presence of parameter measured (eg. PD-L1). This statistical measure shows the variability or dispersion or distribution of cell counts around the mean.
Fields.Comment: The standard deviation of the number of PD-L1 positive cells per square millimeter. This statistical measure shows the variability or dispersion of cell counts around the mean.

Fields.Label: Cells/mm2 Sample Change From Baseline (CfB)
Fields.Description: This gives Change from Baseline (CfB) in the marker (eg. PD-L1) positive cell count per square millimeter. The baseline sample in this case is indicated with PRE. This indicates the absolute difference in PD-L1 positive cell density from the baseline.
Fields.Comment: Change from baseline (cfb) in the sample cell count per square millimeter. This indicates the absolute difference in PD-L1 positive cell density from the baseline (pre-treatment) measurement for the same subject.

Fields.Label: Cells/mm2 Sample Percentage of Change From Baseline (CfB)
Fields.Description: This column gives percentage Change from Baseline (CfB) in the marker (eg. PD-L1) positive cell count per square millimeter. The baseline sample in this case is indicated with PRE. This shows the relative change in cell density compared to the baseline, expressed as a percentage.
Fields.Comment: Percentage change from baseline in the sample cell count per square millimeter. This shows the relative change in cell density compared to the baseline, expressed as a percentage.

Fields.Label: Cells/mm2 Sample Fold Change
Fields.Description: This column gives fold change from baseline in the parameter (PD-L1)positive cell count per square millimeter. This metric shows how many times the positive cell density has increased or decreased compared to the baseline value.
Fields.Comment: Fold change from baseline in the sample cell count per square millimeter. This metric shows how many times the cell density has increased or decreased relative to the baseline value.

Fields.Label: Cells/mm2 Mean Change From Baseline (CfB)
Fields.Description: This gives Change from Baseline (CfB) in the mean of  marker (eg. PD-L1) positive cell count per square millimeter. The baseline sample in this case is indicated with PRE. This indicates the absolute difference in mean of  PD-L1 positive cell density from the baseline across replicates
Fields.Comment: Change from baseline in the mean cell count per square millimeter. This shows the absolute difference in the mean PD-L1 positive cell density from the baseline measurement across samples or replicates.

Fields.Label: Cells/mm2 Mean Percentage of Change From Baseline (CfB)
Fields.Description: This column gives percentage Change from Baseline (CfB) in the marker (eg. PD-L1) positive mean cell count per square millimeter. The baseline sample in this case is indicated with PRE. This shows the relative change in cell density compared to the baseline, expressed as a percentage.
Fields.Comment: Percentage change from baseline in the mean cell count per square millimeter. This gives the relative change in the mean cell density compared to the baseline, expressed as a percentage.

Fields.Label: Cells/mm2 Mean Fold Change
Fields.Description: This column gives fold change from baseline in the parameter (PD-L1)positive mean cell count per square millimeter. This metric shows how many times the positive cell density has increased or decreased compared to the baseline value.
Fields.Comment: Fold change from baseline in the mean cell count per square millimeter. This metric indicates how many times the mean cell density has increased or decreased relative to the baseline value.

GdlDomainDescription: This Biomarker domain contains Immuno Histo Chemistry (IHC) information of the sample dataset
